estimates.assumptions: 3 x 400g cans; knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly; total drained/edible weight equals can contents (standard for canned chopped tomatoes in sauce recipes).
A typical fresh basil bunch weighs ~25-40g; 30g used here as realistic whole-bunch estimate for a sauce recipe; knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
Standard Italian mascarpone tub is ~250g; 2 tubs = 500g total edible weight. CaloriesPer100g estimated from typical mascarpone density (~429 kcal/100g) since field was null.
2 standard mozzarella balls (~125g each when sliced); total 250g edible weight. CaloriesPer100g estimated from typical mozzarella (~280 kcal/100g) since field was null.
Standard ricotta tub is ~250g; 3 tubs = 750g total edible weight; knownCaloriesPer100g and knownGrams logic applied to scale.
A pinch of nutmeg is ~1-3g; 2g used as modest realistic amount for seasoning a large spinach-ricotta mix; knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
